entities.name: Dein Salvasi
entities.description: A wealthy, pious man of Lambholt on Innistrad at the center of mysterious deaths linked to Old Stickfingers.

entities.name: Arinos
entities.description: Farmer who disappeared; he summoned Stickfingers to save his farm.

entities.name: Rem Karolus
entities.description: Inquisitor and monster slayer called by Salvasi.

entities.name: Old Stickfingers
entities.description: Fearsome guardian spirit summoned by Arinos.

entities.name: Ariosa
entities.description: Arinos's daughter who finished the ritual.

events.summary: Arinos disappears after arguing with Salvasi and travelers and locals including Lakil are found dead.
events.quote: the mysterious disappearance of a farmer named Arinos

events.summary: Salvasi calls for Rem Karolus and the council calls for Vadrik.
events.quote: called for the help of Rem Karolus

events.summary: Vadrik and Rem learn that Old Stickfingers was summoned by Arinos to save his farm from Salvasi.
events.quote: Arinos had summoned Stickfingers to save his farm from Salvasi

events.summary: Old Stickfingers attacks Vadrik and Rem and is driven off.
events.quote: the pair temporarily drove it away

events.summary: Vadrik destroys the twig mobile and lets Ariosa finish the ritual, dispelling Stickfingers.
events.quote: Vadrik destroyed the mobile and let Arinos's daughter Ariosa finish the ritual

relations.note: Summoned it; the ritual went awry.
relations.quote: Arinos had summoned Stickfingers to save his farm from Salvasi

relations.note: Argued and threatened to take his farm over debt.
relations.quote: Salvasi, who had been threatening to take it due to debt
